name.description: group.action; CLI `logreq group action`, API `POST /v1/commands/group.action`, MCP tool `group_action`.

title.description: The name of the command for people, English, sentence case, unique in the catalog: what the app's command prompt offers (SR-108, SR-073 AK2) and the MCP tool `title`. When an app action does the same, the title is the action's name, so the prompt lists it once. Free of delete words except for relations (D-045).

effect.description: No command writes to Git (D-036). No command deletes elements (D-045).

stage.description: Stage of D-035 in which the command is built.

arguments.description: How a command prompt asks for the input (SR-108 AK4): every top-level property of `input` exactly once, the required ones first, in the order they are asked. `complete` says where the values to offer come from (a closed list; the app maps each source to one read command of core and decides nothing about what is allowed). `of` names an earlier field the source depends on. Without it, the nearest earlier field of the fitting source: an `element` or `relationTarget` field for status, invalidStatus, relationKind, hint, property and relation (relation also a `relation` field); a `relationKind` field for relationTarget; a `property` field for value. With no such field, status, invalidStatus, relationKind, hint and property give every value of the metamodel or the workspace; relationTarget, relation and value need one. `validate-schemas.mjs` checks the coverage, the order and `of` (`catalog-checks.mjs`).

complete.description: element: elements found by element.search. type: types of the metamodel. status: statuses of the type of the element in `of` (without it, every status of the metamodel). invalidStatus: of those, the ones the metamodel marks invalid. relationKind: kinds that relation.options allows from the element in `of` (without it, every relation kind of the metamodel). relationTarget: elements of the target types of the kind in `of` (element.search with selection.where.type). relation: with `of` an element field, the kinds of the existing relations of that element; with `of` a relation field (the kind asked before), the targets of the relations of that kind (relation.remove: source, kind, target). property: properties of the type of the element in `of` (every property of the metamodel without it). value: the values the metamodel fixes for the property in `of`. hint: open hints of the element in `of` (without it, every open hint). filter: saved filters. repository: repositories of the workspace. selection: the selection of the list shown. choice: the inline `enum` of the property. text, number, boolean: typed free input. json: any other object or mixed field, typed as JSON and checked by core.

output.description: Outputs are JSON objects and say so at the root, also next to a `$ref`: MCP needs `type: object` at the root of an output schema (ADR-0009).
